## Intro

With wonderful surroundings, unique charm and plenty of things to do and see, Lake Geneva is quite enchanting: Enjoy a cruise or take a stroll through the vineyard terraces of Lavaux. Discover Geneva, Lausanne and the Montreux Riviera with Chillon Castle.

## Lake Geneva – Lac Léman at a glance

### That’s Lake Geneva

Lake Geneva (known in French as Lac Léman) is located in the southwest of Switzerland in the cantons of [Vaud](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/canton-of-vaud/), Geneva and [Valais](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/valais/). The lake, which Switzerland shares with France, is a popular destination for its many sights and leisure activities.

### Discover Lake Geneva

[Geneva](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/geneva/), [Lausanne](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/lausanne/), [Vevey](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/vevey/) or [Montreux](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/montreux-riviera/) are all ideal for experiencing the unique flair of Lake Geneva: They share a mild climate, rich culture and plenty of joie de vivre. The winegrowing area of [Lavaux](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/lavaux-vineyard-terraces/) with its charming winegrowing villages is a well known attraction, as are the mountains of [Mont-Pèlerin](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/mont-pelerin/) and [Rochers-de-Naye](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/rochers-de-naye/). You can spend the day sailing, hiking or skiing on and around Lake Geneva and in the evening enjoy the sunset on a lakeside promenade.

### Cruises on Lake Geneva

A [boat trip](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/lake-geneva-cruises/) is probably the most beautiful way to experience Lake Geneva. The views of the towns with their waterfronts, the vineyards and the surrounding peaks are magnificent. [Paddle steamers from the Belle Époque](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/steam-cruises-on-lake-geneva/) regularly ply between [Montreux](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/montreux-riviera/), [Vevey](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/vevey/), [Lausanne](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/lausanne/) and [Geneva](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/geneva/). A special feature in Geneva, boat taxis, known as [mouettes](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/mouettes/), ferry passengers from shore to shore. Thanks to its size and the plentiful supply of wind, Lake Geneva is also the perfect place for sailing fans.

### Chillon Castle

Why not combine your [Lake Geneva cruise](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/lake-geneva-cruises/) with a trip to [Chillon Castle](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/chillon-castle/) near Montreux. The most visited historical monument in Switzerland, the castle is known for its mystical beauty. This is hardly surprising, as it is located on a rocky island directly on the lake shore. You can explore the castle on your own or take a guided tour. The changing exhibitions on the region’s history and culture are exciting.

### Around Lake Geneva

Not far from Lake Geneva is the [Jura Vaudois Nature Park](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/jura-vaudois-nature-park/) with the [Vallée de Joux](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/vallee-de-joux/), an important centre of the watchmaking industry. Excursion destinations in the Rhone Valley include [Aigle Castle](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/chateau-daigle/) and the winter sports resort of [Leysin](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/leysin/) with panoramic views from [Mount Berneuse](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/berneuse-panoramic-views-from-kuklos/). The journey on the [GoldenPass Express](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/experiences/goldenpass-express/) from Montreux to [Interlaken](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/interlaken/), the gateway to the [Jungfrau region](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/destinations/the-jungfrau-region/), is scenically impressive.

### Experience Lake Geneva for less

The [Swiss Travel Pass](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/planning/transport-accommodation/tickets-public-transport/swiss-travel-pass/) and the [Lake Geneva-Alps Regional Pass](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-us/planning/transport-accommodation/tickets-public-transport/regional-passes/regional-pass-lake-geneva-alps/) for five or seven days are worth considering when staying around Lake Geneva: They allow you to travel for free on public transport on two or three days and half-price on the other days.
